key.name: temp-warn
key.description: Panel indicator turns amber at or above this temperature. This is an additional warning: the CPU's own throttle point (TjMax) is read from the kernel and reported independently of this value. Set it above this CPU's throttle point to switch it off.

key.name: temp-crit
key.description: Panel indicator turns orange-red at or above this temperature. The red is kept for a throttle a kernel counter confirmed. This is an additional warning: the CPU's own throttle point (TjMax) is read from the kernel and reported independently of this value. Set it above this CPU's throttle point to switch it off.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often to read thermal sensors and throttle counters. Capped at 60 seconds: the CPU throttle counters are read as deltas between polls, so a longer interval would attribute a burst to a window far larger than the burst itself. Floored at 1 second because the NPU driver documents that as the shortest period at which its busy-time counter can be read without affecting job submission.

key.name: hide-when-nominal
key.summary: Hide the indicator when nothing is throttling
key.description: When enabled, the panel indicator is hidden while all components are nominal, and reappears on a warning or confirmed throttle event.

key.name: notify-on-throttle
key.summary: Send a notification on confirmed throttling
key.description: When enabled, a desktop notification is shown when a confirmed thermal throttle event begins.
